# Bundled assets

- GSAP 3.14.2, GreenSock. Downloaded from the npm distribution. License: [GSAP standard license](https://gsap.com/standard-license/). The distribution header is retained in `gsap.min.js`.
- Geist, Vercel. Latin font subsets are distributed through Fontsource under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. See `../fonts/OFL.txt`.

The application serves these assets locally; no CDN requests are required at runtime.
